title: Sindiwe na Switsayitsayi
description: Ku vile na nhwanyana loyi a vitaniwa Sindiwe Magona.A ri na nyiko yo hlawuleka ya switori. Nivusiku kokwana wa xisati wa Sindiwe u n’wi rungulele switori swa masalamusi hi mayelna na swinghunghumana na makhema, swiharhui swa khwati, na swivumbiwa leswitsongo swa nhova. Lowu a wu ri nkarhi lowu Sindiwe a wu rhandza ngopfu. Vona hilaha a kulaka hakonaku ya hanya mavonavona ya yena n’wini tanihiloko a a fama a tsemakanya malwandle ku ya cinca misava hi switori swa yena.
